Deposit $150 into Steakhouse Financial's flagship vault on Base and keep the receipt tokens in the same wallet Cost: about $3 in gas to deposit. Time: 15 minutes to set up.

Use Bitlo's core product on Ethereum once a week with about $50 of funds, starting with its simplest action rather than its most complex one Cost: about $3 a week in gas. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Hold a balance of about $25 in Bitlo between sessions instead of moving funds in and out for each action Cost: no fee beyond the first deposit. Time: 5 minutes to set up.
Join Bitlo's public testnet or points surface if the protocol runs one, and use it the same way you use the product Cost: no fee, test funds only. Time: 20 minutes to start.

Keep a record of every Bitlo action on Ethereum with the date, the amount and the transaction hash in one file, so the history is ready if Bitlo ever opens a claim Cost: no cost beyond a text file. Time: 5 minutes a month.
